chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from 'Abd Allah ibn Ja'far, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Sayf ibn 'Umayrah, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever carries a جنازة from its four sides, Allah will forgive forty major sins for him.

key_terms.جَنَازَةً: the funeral bier or deceased being carried

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for carrying a جنازة from all four sides in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages participation in carrying the bier of the deceased and highlights the great reward attached to serving a funeral. It portrays this act as a means for divine forgiveness, emphasizing communal responsibility toward the dead and moral benefit for the living.
